days.heading: Drive Cascais → Carvoeiro
days.note: The big mainland drive: Cascais → Carvoeiro is ~285 km / 2h58 before stops. Do not stack a major activity unless everyone is in great shape.

spots.name: Carvoeiro
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · CarvoeiroFlickr

images.alt: Golden cliffs and turquoise water at Carvoeiro.
Rugged cliff coastline near the Alfanzina lighthouse.
Colourful Carvoeiro tumbling down to its cove beach.

spots.cost: Beach free (lifeguarded summer). Town parking meters ~$1/hr. Benagil–Marinha boat: $35 adult / $20 child 3–10.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book the Benagil boat online in advance — kids 3–10 are $20 vs $35; family of 4 ~$115 not $140.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private 2-hr Benagil cave boat charter, ~$165–275 for the boat — go early, at your own pace.
spots.restoHtml:
• Mama Mia — Italian pizza/pasta, ~$11–15 4.1★ (269 rev) — thin-crust pizza + pasta; 3-course set ~$20; tiny, book ahead.
  • Levels Carvoeiro — International/grill, ~$13–20 — explicit kids' plates: mini burgers + 'chicken pops'/fries.
  • Jota Lita — Portuguese family-run (est. 1988), ~$11–15 — does plain burgers for kids, relaxed.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Praia da Marinha ↗ — One of Europe's most famous beaches, ~15 min drive — dramatic arches, clearer & quieter.
    PhotosIG · Praia da MarinhaFlickr
  • Alvor boardwalk ↗ — flat lagoon walk and town snacks when cliffs or boat timing are not working.
    PhotosIG · Alvor boardwalkFlickr
  • Praia de Vale Centeanes ↗ — cliff-backed sandy beach near Carvoeiro with easier logistics than Marinha.
    PhotosIG · Praia de Vale CenteanesFlickr

spots.name: Ferragudo
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · FerragudoFlickr

images.alt: The whitewashed village of Ferragudo above the estuary.
Ferragudo’s beach and moored fishing boats.
Ferragudo waterfront and fishing boats behind agave.

spots.cost: Village + Praia Grande beach free. Small free car parks (limited; arrive early). No entry gates.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Skip a paid boat here — wander the old town + walk to Castelo de São João & the Praia Grande playground, $0.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private sunset Arade-river cruise, ~$130–225 for a small charter as the fishing boats return.
spots.restoHtml:
• O Barril — Portuguese/international, ~$11–15 4.5★ (~2,790 rev) — homemade chips, steak, grilled fish; toddler-friendly.
  • Restaurante Praia Grande — Beachfront terrace, ~$13–20 — on the sand with a playground steps away; grilled fish/chicken/fries.
  • Kalu Beach Bar — Casual light bites on Praia Grande, ~$8.50–15 — burgers, snacks, sea views.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Praia do Pintadinho ↗ — Small, calm, sheltered cove just south with a beach café — better on a windy day or for toddlers.
    PhotosIG · Praia do PintadinhoFlickr
  • Praia de Vale Centeanes ↗ — cliff-backed sandy beach near Carvoeiro with easier logistics than Marinha.
    PhotosIG · Praia de Vale CenteanesFlickr
  • Zoomarine Algarve ↗ — water-park/show day when Slide & Splash feels too intense or the weather is iffy.
    PhotosIG · Zoomarine AlgarveFlickr

days.heading: Lagos / Ponta da Piedade boat day

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Lagos marina, Ponta da Piedade, Praia do Camilo or Meia Praia

days.note: Your western Algarve wow day — worth keeping even though you are not staying in Lagos.

spots.name: Lagos
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · LagosFlickr

images.alt: Golden cliffs of the Lagos coast.
Sculpted sea arches along the Lagos shoreline.
Turquoise grottoes below the Lagos cliffs.

spots.cost: Town + marina free (free playground at north end). Power-boat cave cruise from $20 adult/$15 child; catamaran $55/$40.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Take the $20/$15 power-boat grotto cruise not the $55/$40 catamaran — same scenery, family saves ~$110.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private family cave-and-coast boat from the marina, ~$165–275 for 2 hrs, own swim stops.
spots.restoHtml:
• Portofino's — Italian on the marina, ~$11–15 4.0★ (~1,457 rev) — pizza/pasta/burgers; happy-hour from $6.50.
  • Pizza Real — Old-town pizzeria, ~$10–15 — fresh pizza incl. BBQ chicken, GF/veg on request; picky-eater safety net.
  • Artesão (Marina) — Café/brunch, ~$6.50–13 — pancakes, toasts, wraps; easy low-drama meal.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Praia Dona Ana ↗ — Postcard cliff-backed beach ~10 min from the marina — wide sand, calm water for actual beach time.
    PhotosIG · Praia Dona AnaFlickr
  • Zoomarine Algarve ↗ — water-park/show day when Slide & Splash feels too intense or the weather is iffy.
    PhotosIG · Zoomarine AlgarveFlickr
  • Praia do Pintadinho ↗ — small sheltered cove south of Ferragudo, good on windy days.
    PhotosIG · Praia do PintadinhoFlickr

spots.name: Ponta da Piedade
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Ponta da PiedadeFlickr

images.alt: A golden rock arch over moody teal water at Ponta da Piedade.
Wide aerial of the whole Ponta da Piedade headland toward Lagos.
Kayaks and boats in the turquoise grottoes from above.

spots.cost: Free — no gates/tickets; free parking near the lighthouse. Power-boat from $20/$15; kayak ~$35–50 pp.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save The clifftop boardwalk + 182 steps are free — do the walk yourself, then pick ONE water activity (~$70 family by power boat).
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private family kayak-and-caves guided tour, ~$165–250 — paddle the grottoes with a guide.
spots.restoHtml:
• O Camilo — Portuguese/seafood atop Praia do Camilo, ~$15–25 — closest proper restaurant.
  • Headland kiosk — Seasonal drinks/snack kiosk at the lighthouse — quick refuel only.
  • Portofino's (Lagos, 5 min) — Pizza/pasta fallback for picky kids at the marina.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Praia do Camilo ↗ — Jewel-box beach reached by a photogenic wooden staircase right next door — swim here, then walk the cliffs.
    PhotosIG · Praia do CamiloFlickr
  • Praia do Pintadinho ↗ — small sheltered cove south of Ferragudo, good on windy days.
    PhotosIG · Praia do PintadinhoFlickr
  • Alvor boardwalk ↗ — flat lagoon walk and town snacks when cliffs or boat timing are not working.
    PhotosIG · Alvor boardwalkFlickr

days.heading: Algar Seco + Praia da Marinha + Ferragudo

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Algar Seco, Carvoeiro boardwalk, Praia da Marinha, Ferragudo

days.note: One of the best parent/kid overlap days: rock windows, boardwalk, cliff photos, swimming, and an old fishing-village dinner.

spots.name: Algar Seco
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Algar SecoFlickr

images.alt: Golden limestone cave windows at Algar Seco frame turquoise Atlantic water.
images.credit: Jules Verne Times Two · Google Images source

images.alt: Honey-colored Algar Seco limestone arches and ocean-carved rock under a clear blue sky.
images.credit: Jules Verne Times Two · Google Images source

images.alt: Sunlit Algar Seco sea arch and sculpted Algarve cliffs above deep blue Atlantic water.
images.credit: Jules Verne Times Two · Google Images source

spots.cost: FREE — clifftop boardwalk & rock formations open-air. Free parking (fills fast; arrive before 10am). Optional cave boat/kayak ~$25–45 pp.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Skip the paid Boneca boat — the free boardwalk gives the same views; a family saves ~$130 vs a $35 pp boat.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private kayak/SUP to the Boneca cave and grottoes, ~$35–45 pp.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pistache Pizza & Pasta — Italian, ~$11–15 — thin-crust pizza + simple pasta, exactly picky-kid safe.
  • Mama Mia — Italian, ~$11–15 — pizza/pasta, varied kids' options.
  • MataBixo — Burgers/hot dogs/toasties, ~$8.50–13 — comfort-food menu of burgers, dogs & fries.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Praia de Vale Centeanes ↗ — Quieter cliff-backed sandy beach ~1.5 km east — calm family swim after the boardwalk.
    PhotosIG · Praia de Vale CenteanesFlickr
  • Praia do Camilo ↗ — staircase beach beside Ponta da Piedade, better for a swim after the viewpoint.
    PhotosIG · Praia do CamiloFlickr
  • Alvor boardwalk ↗ — flat lagoon walk and town snacks when cliffs or boat timing are not working.
    PhotosIG · Alvor boardwalkFlickr
spots.bloglinksHtml: Family photo-spot tips ↗Best caves tips for families ↗

spots.name: Praia da Marinha
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Praia da MarinhaFlickr

images.alt: The sculpted arches above Praia da Marinha.
Emerald water lapping the Marinha cliffs.
The iconic twin-arch "M" formation over emerald water.

spots.cost: FREE beach + free clifftop parking (fills by ~9am, road then closed until ~3pm). Steep staircase to the sand.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Arrive before 9am to grab the free lot and dodge the road closure — no private parking or taxi later.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private small-boat photo tour of the Marinha arches + Benagil from Carvoeiro, ~$225+ for the family.
spots.restoHtml:
• O Algar (Benagil) — Portuguese/seafood + burgers, ~$13–20 4.6★ Google — high chairs, kids' ice creams, burgers/ribs.
  • Marinha beach café — Snacks/toasties/drinks, ~$5.50–11 (cash only) — plain toasties & chips right on the sand.
  • Carvoeiro pizza (12 min) — Pistache/Mama Mia — reliable picky-kid pizza/pasta backup.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Sete Vales Suspensos trail ↗ — The 7-km clifftop 'Seven Hanging Valleys' walk starts here — short there-and-back for epic arches, no crowds.
    PhotosIG · Sete Vales Suspensos trailFlickr
  • Alvor boardwalk ↗ — flat lagoon walk and town snacks when cliffs or boat timing are not working.
    PhotosIG · Alvor boardwalkFlickr
  • Praia de Vale Centeanes ↗ — cliff-backed sandy beach near Carvoeiro with easier logistics than Marinha.
    PhotosIG · Praia de Vale CenteanesFlickr

days.heading: Kid-first day: Slide & Splash or pool/beach
days.note: The intentional kid day. If parents are feeling too much water, swap the morning to Silves Castle and keep the afternoon as pool time.

spots.name: Slide & Splash
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Slide & SplashFlickr

images.alt: Bright blue and red waterslides against a clear sky.
A colourful kids’ aqua-play splash structure over the pool.
Aerial of the big resort water park and its slides.

spots.cost: 2026: adult (11–64) $35 low/$40 high; junior (≥1m, ≤10) $25/$30; baby <1m free. Online = 10% off. Family (2+2) high season ≈ $135 gate / $120 online. Open Apr–Oct.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Buy online for 10% off (~$4/adult) — family saves ~$13–15 and skips the ticket queue. BYO picnic allowed.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Rent a shaded sunbed/gazebo for the day (~$15–35) so parents have a home base.
spots.restoHtml:
• On-site self-service — Buffet + snack bars: burgers, chicken/nuggets, chips, pizza, ice cream — standard picky-kid fare. No re-entry.
  • BYO picnic — Bringing your own food is allowed — caps the day's total.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Zoomarine Algarve (Guia) ↗ — Swap slides for dolphin/sea-lion shows + gentler water play — better for younger/less-daring kids. Adult $40.
    PhotosIG · Zoomarine AlgarveFlickr
  • Alvor boardwalk ↗ — flat lagoon walk and town snacks when ticketed attractions feel like too much.
    PhotosIG · Alvor boardwalkFlickr
  • Praia de Vale Centeanes ↗ — cliff-backed sandy beach near Carvoeiro with easier logistics than Marinha.
    PhotosIG · Praia de Vale CenteanesFlickr

spots.name: Silves Castle
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Silves CastleFlickr

images.alt: Aerial of the red sandstone Castelo de Silves.
The red sandstone Moorish castle on the hill above Silves.
Silves rooftops beneath the castle and cathedral.

spots.cost: Adult $3; combined Castle + Museum $4.50; child/student/65+ $1.50. Jun–Aug 9am–11pm. Free street parking (walk up the hill). Reconfirm 2027 at the gate.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Buy the combined Castle + Museum ticket ($4.50) rather than both separately; kids/over-65 just $1.50 each.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Lunch at famous seafood spot Marisqueira Rui in the old town, ~$35–55 pp.
spots.restoHtml:
• Café Inglês — Café/pizza/platters, ~$8.50–15 — 'lovely thin, crispy' pizza, cakes, simple plates; steps from the castle.
  • Café Castelo de Silves — Café/light meals, ~$6.50–13 — in the castle courtyard; easy snacks/sandwiches mid-visit.
  • Old-town pizza/family spots — Pizza/pasta, ~$11–15 — plenty of family cafés a short walk downhill.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Silves Cathedral (Sé) ↗ — Right beside the castle — quick add-on with Moorish/Gothic history and views.
    PhotosIG · Silves CathedralFlickr
  • Zoomarine Algarve ↗ — water-park/show day when Slide & Splash feels too intense or the weather is iffy.
    PhotosIG · Zoomarine AlgarveFlickr
  • Praia do Pintadinho ↗ — small sheltered cove south of Ferragudo, good on windy days.
    PhotosIG · Praia do PintadinhoFlickr

days.heading: Flexible Algarve day

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Choose one: Benagil boat, Silves, Praia da Marinha repeat, pool, Ferragudo

days.note: The pressure-release day. Do not over-plan it. Use it for the thing that weather or energy prevented earlier.

spots.name: Benagil Cave
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Benagil CaveFlickr

images.alt: Aerial of the Benagil cove and beach.
Turquoise water at the mouth of Benagil cave.
The little beach tucked inside the Benagil cove.

spots.cost: ⚠ Swimming INTO the cave is BANNED since Aug 2024 (fines up to $2,700). Legal: group motorboat ~$20–40 pp, or guided kayak/SUP ~$20–40 pp (max 8 min inside, no landing). Cheapest departure: Carvoeiro.
spots.climate: 75°F day / 63°F night, ~1 rainy day. Sea 65°F (59–73°F) — cool but swimmable.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book a group speedboat from Carvoeiro (closest port) at ~$25 pp — family of 4 ~$110 vs $225–325+ private.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private family boat charter into the cave, ~$165–325 depending on size/duration.
spots.restoHtml:
• O Algar — Portuguese/seafood + burgers, ~$13–20 4.6★ Google — overlooks Benagil beach, high chairs, kids' menu.
  • Benagil beach snack bars — Grilled/seafood/snacks, ~$8.50–15 — plain grilled chicken, chips, toasties on the beachfront.
  • Carvoeiro Italians (10 min) — Pistache/Mama Mia — pizza/pasta picky-kid backup.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Praia da Marinha (2 km W) ↗ — Combine as one trip — unbeatable arches and calmer swimming than crowded Benagil beach.
    PhotosIG · Praia da MarinhaFlickr
  • Praia do Pintadinho ↗ — small sheltered cove south of Ferragudo, good on windy days.
    PhotosIG · Praia do PintadinhoFlickr
  • Praia do Camilo ↗ — staircase beach beside Ponta da Piedade, better for a swim after the viewpoint.
    PhotosIG · Praia do CamiloFlickr
